layman_headline: Market is hot but pullbacks are hitting hard — sitting tight and watching our XRP position.
layman_explanation: The crypto market just had a massive rally week — Bitcoin up 21%, Ethereum up 27%, and XRP up 43% in 7 days. But today everything is pulling back, which is normal after such a big run. Our XRP position is down 8.3% from entry because we bought near the top of that surge. The candidates for new trades are either overbought, have no technical data available, or are stablecoins — none offer a compelling risk-reward setup right now.
layman_action: Hold your current XRP position as long as it stays above $1.30 stop-loss. Don't add new positions — the market ran too far too fast and needs to cool off before offering clean entries.
expert_reasoning: The entire market just experienced an explosive 7-day rally with BTC +21.5%, ETH +27.6%, and many alts +30-50%. This kind of move typically needs consolidation before continuation. XRP at $1.43 is down 8.3% from our $1.56 entry but still above the $1.30 stop-loss. The swing candidates are uniformly poor: PUMP has RSI 86 (deeply overbought), MON/LIT/XRP all show negative signal scores from being extended, and no candidates have MACD or volume data to confirm setups. BTC dominance at 59.3% remains high, pressuring alts. Fear & Greed dropped from 74 to 65, suggesting the euphoria is fading. The prudent move is to hold XRP with the existing stop-loss and wait for either a deeper pullback to create new entries or for our position to recover toward target.
risk_factors: XRP could break below $1.30 stop-loss if the broader pullback accelerates — we'd exit at ~17% loss
BTC dominance at 59.3% is high and rising, which historically suppresses alt rallies
Bitcoin's quantum vulnerability news from CryptoSlate could create FUD and trigger broader selling
watch_list: XRP price action around $1.35-1.40 support — if it holds, recovery toward $1.85 target is viable
Bitcoin's ability to hold $75K-76K as support after the 21.5% weekly rally
Fear & Greed index trend — dropped from 74 to 65 in one day, further decline would signal risk-off
market_context: The crypto market is in a broad cooling-off phase after an explosive week — BTC +21.5%, ETH +27.6%, with most top 20 assets red in the last 24 hours. Fear & Greed dropped sharply from 74 to 65, and BTC dominance remains elevated at 59.3%, making this a challenging environment for new alt entries.
context_banner: After a blistering 7-day rally across crypto, the market is pulling back — patience is the edge right now.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed dropped sharply from 74 to 65 in 24 hours, signaling cooling euphoria after the massive rally — not the time to chase entries.
PUMP's RSI at 86 is deeply overbought, confirming the broader market is extended and correction risk is elevated across swing candidates.
No swing candidates show volume-vs-average data or confirmed breakout patterns, leaving no clean technical entries available.
Bitcoin's quantum vulnerability reaching US Treasury discussion introduces a potential FUD catalyst that could accelerate the current pullback.
Bitcoin entering 'initial phase of new bull market' per CryptoQuant suggests the broader trend is up, supporting holding XRP through this pullback rather than panic selling.
